articles.summary: Dark violet ground with fine magenta and cyan concentric spiral contours and dense granular points, satin sparkle. Reads as a galaxy-spiral purple and blue with a starry glitter; the rings give broad bands and the dots a fine sparkle.
articles.what: Deep purple to blue to black cosmos panel shift evoking vast interstellar darkness Up close: One big swirling vortex of concentric wobbly rings in magenta-purple and teal-blue over a dark violet ground, tightening toward the centre. A dense scatter of tiny white and pink star dots sits on top of everything. From a distance: Reads as a galaxy-spiral purple and blue with a starry glitter; the rings give broad bands and the dots a fine sparkle. Measured spec (average): metal 97, roughness 116, coat 88. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: hero panel, hood, roof.

tips: Single centred spiral: put the swirl centre on the hood, roof or a big side panel as the hero

White numbers with a dark outline read; purple, blue or pink numbers are lost in the stars.

pitfalls: Not a plain purple-blue-black shift: the render shows one spiral of rings, not smooth panel shift
Not nebula clouds: the rings are crisp and concentric
Avoid: numbers over spiral, next to other busy patterns.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: the vortex and stars already fill the panel; a simple bold stripe or block in white or black: calm frame for the busy sky
